name: Galactic Cruise

categories.label: VP on track (AGM A/B and in play)
categories.hint: Everything scored before the final AGM (launches, section 1/2 progress, etc.). Track continues past 100/200.

categories.label: Cockpits
categories.hint: Sum of each Cockpit's criteria; -5 for each ship never launched.

categories.label: Ship Segments
categories.hint: VP printed on each built Ship Segment.

categories.label: Progress Scoring (Section 3)
categories.hint: (Your cubes in section 3 incl. overflow + 1 if most Reputation) x revealed Wings.

categories.label: Reputation track
categories.hint: VP of the highest threshold reached on the Reputation Track.

categories.label: Developments
categories.hint: VP of the rightmost empty column in the Development area.

categories.label: Leftover supplies
categories.hint: Resources, money, ads, agenda cards and blueprints: 1 VP per 3.

categories.label: Progress cubes on track (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Total your Progress Cubes on the Progress Track.

tiebreakers.description: Most Progress Cubes on the Progress Track
Then the tied player later in turn order.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Reputation and Developments values are printed on the player board so they are entered directly. Enter the VP track as it stands before AGM C scoring. The mostReputation input is 1 if you alone or tied hold the most Reputation (ties all get the extra cube). Tiebreak 'VP from Cockpits' duplicates the cockpits category value.
